chemistry-killer-04.title: Ibhondi ye-ion, ibhondi ye-covalent kunye ne-oxidation-reduction
chemistry-killer-04.topic: Ibhondi ye-ion, ibhondi ye-covalent kunye ne-oxidation-reduction
chemistry-killer-04.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
chemistry-killer-04.material:
Kwi-25 °C, v mL ye-$\mathrm{NaOH(aq)}$ engaziwa ukuxinana kwayo yongezwa kwi-50 mL ye-1.0 M $\mathrm{HCl(aq)}$, kwaye ubushushu obuphezulu bengxubevange buyalinganiswa. Zombini izisombululo zikwi-20.0 °C ngaphambi kokuxuba.
Umthamo we-HCl, v (mL): 0 / 10 / 25 / 40 / 50
Ubushushu obuphezulu emva kokuxuba (°C): 20.0 / 24.5 / 29.0 / 27.5 / 26.75
Cinga ukuba ingxubevange inoxinano olungu-1.0 g/mL nobushushu obuthile obungu-4.0 J/(g·°C), imithamo iyadibaniswa, kwaye akukho bushushu bulahlekileyo. Intsabela yi-$\mathrm{H^+ + OH^- ightarrow H_2O}$. Sesiphi isibini esinika ngokuchanekileyo ukuxinana kwe-HCl(aq) kunye nobushushu bokungathathi cala (ubushushu obukhutshwe kwi-1 mol yamanzi eyenziweyo, kJ/mol), ngokulandelelana?

chemistry-killer-04.s.s1.prompt:
Kwi-25 °C, v mL ye-$\mathrm{NaOH(aq)}$ engaziwa ukuxinana kwayo yongezwa kwi-50 mL ye-1.0 M $\mathrm{HCl(aq)}$, kwaye ubushushu obuphezulu bengxubevange buyalinganiswa. Zombini izisombululo zikwi-20.0 °C ngaphambi kokuxuba.
Umthamo we-HCl, v (mL): 0 / 10 / 25 / 40 / 50
Ubushushu obuphezulu emva kokuxuba (°C): 20.0 / 24.5 / 29.0 / 27.5 / 26.75
Cinga ukuba ingxubevange inoxinano olungu-1.0 g/mL nobushushu obuthile obungu-4.0 J/(g·°C), imithamo iyadibaniswa, kwaye akukho bushushu bulahlekileyo. Intsabela yi-$\mathrm{H^+ + OH^- ightarrow H_2O}$. Sesiphi isibini esinika ngokuchanekileyo ukuxinana kwe-HCl(aq) kunye nobushushu bokungathathi cala (ubushushu obukhutshwe kwi-1 mol yamanzi eyenziweyo, kJ/mol), ngokulandelelana?
chemistry-killer-04.s.s1.explain:
Inyathelo 1: Ubushushu buyanyuka ngokunyuka kwe-v, bufikelele kwi-29.0 °C kwi-25 mL, emva koko buyehla njengoko isisombululo esingasabelanga siqokelela (kwaye umthamo opheleleyo ukhula). Ngoko kwi-25 mL, i-H+ ne-OH- zisabela ngqo.
Inyathelo 2: I-NaOH = 1.0 M x 0.050 L = 0.050 mol isabela 1:1 ne-HCl, ngoko i-0.050 mol ye-HCl ikwi-25 mL: 0.050 / 0.025 = 2.0 M.
Inyathelo 3: Q = mcΔT = (50 + 25 mL x 1.0 g/mL) x 4.0 x 9.0 = 75 x 4.0 x 9.0 = 2700 J.
Inyathelo 4: Ubushushu bokungathathi cala = 2700 J / 0.050 mol = 54000 J/mol = 54 kJ/mol.
Khangela: kwi-v = 10 mL, i-0.020 mol ye-H+ isabela, ΔT = 0.020 x 54000 / (60 x 4.0) = 4.5, ngoko 24.5 °C. Kwi-40 mL, i-0.050 mol ye-OH- isabela, ΔT = 2700 / (90 x 4.0) = 7.5, ngoko 27.5 °C.
Iimpendulo: 2.0 M, 54 kJ/mol (d). (Ezinye ezingachanekanga: i-36 kJ/mol isebenzisa ubunzima be-50 g; i-108 kJ/mol isebenzisa i-0.025 mol yamanzi.)
